This directory vendors mpc-sample-sdk revision 87d3ec20e6b8d46b0580a4fd7f0f39ca3fcd7caf (MIT). The local change adds the full MIDI status to surface events and an optional non-blocking surface observer called before the SDK module mutex. A physical pad release may otherwise be skipped or not reach the note-off hook in 16 Levels. The observer must not block, allocate, retain pointers, or invoke SDK hooks. The optional real-time note interceptor runs on the native callback thread before the module mutex, allowing explicitly selected events to be handled even during a UI paint. It must not allocate, block, retain pointers, or call the module dispatcher. Unhandled events keep the original SDK behavior.
